Class.name: IHC.ITF.Operation.ShRemitCff
Class.Description: This class has method to call the select heatlh Stored procedures and also generate the EFT file if call is successful

Parameter.name: ADAPTER
Parameter.Description: This class is used to write the EDIFECS data from Oracle server to a file

Property.name: Remittance835DataFileNameWithLocation
Property.Description: File name to write the SQL data. Provide with path, e.g /tmp/data.txt

Method.name: Process835RestultSet
Method.Description: Method to process the result set and generate file The methods reads the result set sequentially and expects it to have the result sent in sequence. The output file has following structure CKPYREFID%%%_SEQNO%%%%LO%%%%SEGMENT%%%%ELEMENT%%%%ELEMENTVALUE%%%%
